transcript.pronunciation_roman: - No , I won 't. - Let me . - You 're playing that card ? - I can 't breathe . What is this ?

translations.ja: 「いや、読まないよ」「僕にさせてよ」「その手を使うの？」「息ができないよ。何これ？」
translations.en: - No, I won't. - Let me. - You're playing that card? - I can't breathe. What is this?
translations.ko: - 아니, 안 읽을래. - 내가 할게. - 그런 카드를 꺼낸다고? - 숨을 못 쉬겠어. 이게 뭐야?
translations.zh-TW: - 不，我不要。- 讓我來。- 你要打這張牌？- 我喘不過氣了。這什麼東西？
translations.id: - Tidak, aku tidak mau. - Biar aku saja. - Kamu pakai kartu itu? - Aku tidak bisa bernapas. Apa ini?
translations.pt: - Não, não vou. - Deixe-me. - Vai jogar essa carta? - Não consigo respirar. O que é isto?

transcript.text: This is your secret mission. Accomplish it, and keep it a secret. Don't get caught until the time of revelation.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ディス・イズ・ユア・シークレット・ミッション・アンプリッシュ・イット、アンド・キープ・イット・ア・シークレット
transcript.pronunciation_roman: This is your secret mission . Accomplish it , and keep it a secret . Don 't get caught until the time of revelation .

translations.ja: これは君たちのシークレットミッションです。達成し、秘密にしておいてください。明かされる時まで見つからないようにね。
translations.en: This is your secret mission. Accomplish it, and keep it a secret. Don't get caught until the time of revelation.
translations.ko: 이것은 당신의 비밀 임무입니다. 완수하고 비밀로 유지하세요. 폭로의 시간이 올 때까지 들키지 마세요.
translations.zh-TW: 這是你們的秘密任務。完成它，並保密。在揭曉時刻到來之前，千萬別被抓包。
translations.id: Ini adalah misi rahasia kalian. Selesaikan, dan simpan sebagai rahasia. Jangan sampai ketahuan hingga waktu pengungkapan tiba.
translations.pt: Esta é a sua missão secreta. Conclua-a e mantenha-a em segredo. Não seja pego até o momento da revelação.

transcript.text: "If you're not close with me, get lost, but please stick the stars on them?" Attach a "star hair clip" on Ming Ming and Neptune, and don't let them know ever.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: イフ・ユア・ノット・クロース・ウィズ・ミー、ゲット・ロスト、バット・プリーズ・スティック・ザ・スターズ・オン・ゼム
transcript.pronunciation_roman: "If you 're not close with me , get lost , but please stick the stars on them ?" Attach a "star hair clip " on Ming Ming and Neptune , and don 't let them know ever .

translations.ja: 「仲良くないなら失せろ、でも星を貼ってくれる？ミンミンとネプチューンに星のヘアクリップをつけて、本人たちには絶対に気づかれないようにしてね」
translations.en: "If you're not close with me, get lost, but please stick the stars on them?" Attach a "star hair clip" on Ming Ming and Neptune, and don't let them know ever.
translations.ko: "나랑 안 친하면 꺼져, 하지만 별들을 그들에게 붙여줄래?" 밍밍과 넵튠에게 "별 모양 헤어핀"을 붙여주고, 절대 들키지 마세요.
translations.zh-TW: "如果你跟我不是很熟就滾開，但請把星星貼在他們身上？"在 Ming Ming 和 Neptune 身上貼上「星星髮夾」，而且絕對不能讓他們發現。
translations.id: "Jika kamu tidak akrab denganku, enyah sana, tapi tolong tempelkan bintang-bintang pada mereka?" Tempelkan "jepit rambut bintang" pada Ming Ming dan Neptune, dan jangan biarkan mereka tahu selamanya.
translations.pt: "Se você não é íntimo, vaza, mas por favor colhe as estrelas neles?" Prenda um "grampo de cabelo de estrela" em Ming Ming e Neptune, e nunca deixe que eles saibam.

transcript.text: --- attach a star--- 3 stars --- Take those 3.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アタッチ・ア・スター・スリー・スターズ・テイク・トウズ・スリー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: --- attach a star--- 3 stars --- Take those 3 .

translations.ja: 星を…3つつけよう。その3つを取って。
translations.en: --- attach a star--- 3 stars --- Take those 3.
translations.ko: --- 별을 붙이기--- 별 3개 --- 그 3개를 가져가.
translations.zh-TW: ——貼上星星——3 顆星星——拿那 3 顆。
translations.id: --- tempelkan bintang--- 3 bintang --- Ambil ketiga itu.
translations.pt: --- prender uma estrela--- 3 estrelas --- Pegue aquelas 3.

transcript.text: - But I have no idea that today--- - What? - You're going to make a bow tie? Make it look good. - Here. - Just one--- - Don't repeat that flashback.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: バット・アイ・ハヴ・ノー・アイディア・ザット・トゥデイ・ホワット・ユア・ゴーイング・トゥ・メイク・ア・ボウ・タイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: - But I have no idea that today--- - What ? - You 're going to make a bow tie ? Make it look good . - Here . - Just one--- - Don 't repeat that flashback .

translations.ja: 「でも今日こんなことになるとは思ってなかったよ」「何が？」「蝶ネクタイを作るつもり？うまくやってよ」「ほら」「ひとつだけ…」「さっきのフラッシュバックを繰り返さないでよ」
translations.en: - But I have no idea that today--- - What? - You're going to make a bow tie? Make it look good. - Here. - Just one--- - Don't repeat that flashback.
translations.ko: - 하지만 오늘 이런 일이 있을 줄은 꿈에도 몰랐지--- - 뭐야? - 나비넥타이를 매준다고? 그럴싸하게 만들어 봐. - 여기. - 딱 하나만--- - 그 과거 회상은 반복하지 마.
translations.zh-TW: - 但我根本不知道今天——- 什麼？- 你要打蝴蝶結？把它弄好看一點。- 這裡。- 只有一個——- 別一直重播那個畫面。
translations.id: - Tapi aku tidak tahu hari ini--- - Apa? - Kamu akan membuat dasi kupu-kupu? Buat yang bagus. - Ini. - Cuma satu--- - Jangan ulangi kilas balik itu.
translations.pt: - Mas eu não fazia ideia de que hoje--- - O quê? - Você vai fazer uma gravata borboleta? Faça ficar bonito. - Aqui. - Apenas um--- - Não repita esse flashback.

transcript.text: That's cute. Take a sip of water, my child. Take it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ザッツ・キュート・テイク・ア・シップ・オブ・ウォーター、マイ・チャイルド・テイク・イット
transcript.pronunciation_roman: That 's cute . Take a sip of water , my child . Take it .

translations.ja: かわいいね。お水ひと口飲みなさい、我が子よ。飲みなさい。
translations.en: That's cute. Take a sip of water, my child. Take it.
translations.ko: 귀엽네. 물 한 모금 마셔라, 이 아이야. 마셔.
translations.zh-TW: 真可愛。喝口水吧，孩子。喝吧。
translations.id: Lucu sekali. Minumlah sedikit air, Nak. Minumlah.
translations.pt: Isso é fofo. Tome um gole de água, meu filho. Tome.

transcript.text: He walks too far, out to the Soi entrance, eh? You're back with the ice? In case you're hungry. You like having ice. You can't be serious. How much?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ヒー・ウォークス・トゥ・ファー、アウト・トゥ・ザ・ソイ・エントランス、エー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: He walks too far , out to the Soi entrance , eh ? You 're back with the ice ? In case you 're hungry . You like having ice . You can 't be serious . How much ?

translations.ja: あの子、路地の入り口まで遠くに行っちゃったな。氷を持って戻ってきたの？お腹が空いたときのためにね。氷が好きだもんね。冗談だろ。いくらだった？
translations.en: He walks too far, out to the Soi entrance, eh? You're back with the ice? In case you're hungry. You like having ice. You can't be serious. How much?
translations.ko: 너무 멀리 걸어갔네, 소이 입구까지 갔나? 얼음 가지고 돌아왔어? 배고플까 봐. 너 얼음 먹는 거 좋아하잖아. 설마 진심이겠어? 얼마야?
translations.zh-TW: 他走太遠了，走到巷口了吧？你帶著冰塊回來了？以防你肚子餓。你喜歡吃冰塊。你不是認真的吧。多少錢？
translations.id: Dia berjalan terlalu jauh, sampai ke depan jalan masuk Soi, ya? Kamu kembali membawa es? Kalau-kalau kamu lapar. Kamu suka makan es. Kamu pasti bergurau. Berapa banyak?
translations.pt: Ele anda longe demais, até a entrada do Soi, hein? Você voltou com o gelo? Caso esteja com fome. Você gosta de ter gelo. Você não pode estar falando sério. Quanto?

transcript.text: - Ice, eat it. - Who are going to pay? If I do it. Who are going to pay? I am. My teeth broke.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アイス、イート・イット・フー・アー・ゴーイング・トゥ・ペイ・イフ・アイ・ドゥ・イット
transcript.pronunciation_roman: - Ice , eat it . - Who are going to pay ? If I do it . Who are going to pay ? I am . My teeth broke .

translations.ja: 「氷だ、食べて」「誰が払うの？僕がやるなら。誰が払うの？僕だよ。歯が折れちゃった」
translations.en: - Ice, eat it. - Who are going to pay? If I do it. Who are going to pay? I am. My teeth broke.
translations.ko: - 얼음, 먹어. - 누가 돈을 내지? 내가 하면. 누가 돈을 내냐고? 내가 내지. 내 이가 부러졌잖아.
translations.zh-TW: - 冰塊，吃吧。- 誰要付錢？如果我做的話。誰要付錢？我來。我的牙齒斷了。
translations.id: - Es, makanlah. - Siapa yang akan bayar? Kalau aku yang melakukannya. Siapa yang akan bayar? Aku. Gigiku patah.
translations.pt: - Gelo, coma. - Quem vai pagar? Se eu fizer isso. Quem vai pagar? Eu. Meu dente quebrou.

transcript.text: If Offroad wants me to do, I'll do it for you. Let's go for another round. Let's get started. You fool. Don't you dare to have hope to see this message.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: イフ・オフロード・ウォンツ・ミー・トゥ・ドゥ、アイル・ドゥ・イット・フォー・ユー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: If Offroad wants me to do , I 'll do it for you . Let 's go for another round . Let 's get started . You fool . Don 't you dare to have hope to see this message .

translations.ja: オフロードがやってほしいなら、やってあげるよ。もう一回行こうか。始めよう。バカだな。このメッセージを見る希望なんて持たないこったね。
translations.en: If Offroad wants me to do, I'll do it for you. Let's go for another round. Let's get started. You fool. Don't you dare to have hope to see this message.
translations.ko: 오프로드가 해달라면, 너를 위해 해줄게. 한 판 더 가자. 시작하자. 바보 같은 녀석. 이 메시지를 볼 수 있을 거란 희망은 품지도 마.
translations.zh-TW: 如果 Offroad 要我做，我幫你做就是了。我們再來一輪。開始吧。你這個笨蛋。別妄想能看到這個訊息。
translations.id: Jika Offroad ingin aku melakukannya, aku akan melakukannya untukmu. Ayo kita mulai ronde lagi. Mari kita mulai. Bodoh sekali. Jangan berharap bisa melihat pesan ini.
translations.pt: Se o Offroad quiser que eu faça, eu faço por você. Vamos para outra rodada. Vamos começar. Seu tolo. Não ouse ter esperança de ver esta mensagem.

transcript.text: Get out of my house now. You want to hurt me again?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ゲット・アウト・オブ・マイ・ハウス・ナウ・ユー・ウォント・トゥ・ハート・ミー・アゲイン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Get out of my house now . You want to hurt me again ?

translations.ja: 今すぐ僕の家から出ていってよ。また僕を傷つけたいわけ？
translations.en: Get out of my house now. You want to hurt me again?
translations.ko: 당장 내 집에서 나가. 나를 또 상처 입히고 싶어?
translations.zh-TW: 現在滾出我的房子。你想再次傷害我嗎？
translations.id: Keluar dari rumahku sekarang. Kamu mau menyakitiku lagi?
translations.pt: Saia da minha casa agora. Quer me machucar de novo?

transcript.text: I've had enough. You only want to stab me every time. - Get out. - This is how I solve the problem.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アイヴ・ハッド・エナフ・ユー・オンリィ・ウォント・トゥ・スタブ・ミー・エブリ・タイム・ゲット・アウト
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I 've had enough . You only want to stab me every time . - Get out . - This is how I solve the problem .

translations.ja: もうたくさんだ。君はいつも僕の心を突き刺したいだけなんだから。「出ていけよ」「これが僕の問題の解決方法さ」
translations.en: I've had enough. You only want to stab me every time. - Get out. - This is how I solve the problem.
translations.ko: 이제 진절머리가 나. 너는 늘 나를 찌를 생각만 하잖아. - 나가. - 이게 내가 문제를 해결하는 방식이지.
translations.zh-TW: 我受夠了。你每次只想捅我一刀。- 滾。- 這就是我解決問題的方式。
translations.id: Aku sudah muak. Kamu hanya ingin menusukku setiap waktu. - Keluar. - Beginilah cara aku menyelesaikan masalah.
translations.pt: Já chega. Você só quer me apunhalar todas as vezes. - Saiam. - É assim que eu resolvo o problema.

transcript.text: There's nothing holding me back anymore. If you don't get out, take it. I'll seal off my nose holes until I die.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ゼアズ・ナッシング・ホールド・ミー・バック・エニモア・イフ・ユー・ドント・ゲット・アウト、テイク・イット
transcript.pronunciation_roman: There 's nothing holding me back anymore . If you don 't get out , take it . I 'll seal off my nose holes until I die .

translations.ja: もう何も僕を引き留めるものはない。出ていかないなら、これを受け取れ。死ぬまで自分の鼻の穴を塞いじゃうからな。
translations.en: There's nothing holding me back anymore. If you don't get out, take it. I'll seal off my nose holes until I die.
translations.ko: 이제 나를 막을 건 없어. 안 나가겠다면, 이걸 받아라. 죽을 때까지 내 콧구멍을 막아버릴 테다.
translations.zh-TW: 再也沒有什麼能阻止我了。如果你不滾出去，接招吧。我要把我的鼻孔封起來直到我死。
translations.id: Tidak ada lagi yang menahanku. Jika kamu tidak keluar, terimalah ini. Aku akan menutup lubang hidungku sampai aku mati.
translations.pt: Não há mais nada me segurando. Se você não sair, aguente. Vou tapar as narinas até morrer.

transcript.text: We'd better go.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ウィード・ベター・ゴー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: We 'd better go .

translations.ja: 僕たちは行ったほうがよさそうだね。
translations.en: We'd better go.
translations.ko: 우리 그냥 나가는 게 좋겠어.
translations.zh-TW: 我們還是走吧。
translations.id: Sebaiknya kita pergi.
translations.pt: É melhor a gente ir.

transcript.text: No, that's a key message--- Wait, I need to see if I left the other key messages. You have no guts? There, I say, and you did it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ノー、ザッツ・ア・キー・メッセージ・ウェイト、アイ・ニード・トゥ・シー・イフ・アイ・レフト・ザ・ザー・キー・メッセージ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: No , that 's a key message--- Wait , I need to see if I left the other key messages . You have no guts ? There , I say , and you did it .

translations.ja: いや、それは重要なメッセージだ…待って、他の重要なメッセージを置いてきちゃったか確認しなきゃ。度胸がないのかって？ほら、僕が言ったら、君はちゃんとやったじゃないか。
translations.en: No, that's a key message--- Wait, I need to see if I left the other key messages. You have no guts? There, I say, and you did it.
translations.ko: 아니, 그게 핵심 메시지인데--- 잠깐, 다른 핵심 메시지를 두고 왔는지 봐야겠어. 너 배짱이 없네? 자, 내가 말하니까 네가 했잖아.
translations.zh-TW: 不，那是關鍵訊息——等等，我得看看我有没有漏掉其他關鍵訊息。你們沒膽嗎？你看，我話才剛說，你們就做了。
translations.id: Tidak, itu pesan kunci--- Tunggu, aku harus melihat apakah aku meninggalkan pesan kunci yang lain. Kamu tidak punya nyali? Tuh kan, kubilang, dan kamu melakukannya.
translations.pt: Não, essa é uma mensagem-chave--- Espera, preciso ver se deixei as outras mensagens-chave. Você não tem coragem? Pronto, eu disse e você fez.

transcript.text: They took time preparing the bed for us. The bed is tempting us to lie down.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ゼイ・トゥーク・タイム・プレパリング・ザ・ベッド・フォー・アス・ザ・ベッド・イズ・テンプティング・アス・トゥ・ライ・ダウン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: They took time preparing the bed for us . The bed is tempting us to lie down .

translations.ja: 僕たちのために時間をかけてベッドを準備してくれたんだね。ベッドが横になるように誘惑してくるよ。
translations.en: They took time preparing the bed for us. The bed is tempting us to lie down.
translations.ko: 우리를 위해 침대를 정성껏 준비했네. 침대가 우리를 누우라고 유혹하고 있어.
translations.zh-TW: 他們花時間幫我們鋪好床。這張床誘惑著我們躺上去。
translations.id: Mereka meluangkan waktu menyiapkan tempat tidur untuk kita. Tempat tidurnya menggoda kita untuk berbaring.
translations.pt: Eles demoraram para arrumar a cama para nós. A cama está nos tentando a deitar.

transcript.text: - I haven't slept today. - That's all right. - (Team) You're really dozing off? - Not yet.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アイ・ハヴント・スレプト・トゥデイ・ザッツ・オール・ライト・チーム・ユア・リアリー・ドージング・オフ・ノット・イェット
transcript.pronunciation_roman: - I haven 't slept today . - That 's all right . - (Team) You 're really dozing off ? - Not yet .

translations.ja: 「今日まだ寝てないんだ」「大丈夫だよ」「（チーム）本当にうたた寝してるの？」「まだだよ」
translations.en: - I haven't slept today. - That's all right. - (Team) You're really dozing off? - Not yet.
translations.ko: - 오늘 잠을 못 잤어. - 괜찮아. - (팀) 진짜 조는 거야? - 아직 아니야.
translations.zh-TW: - 我今天還沒睡。- 沒關係。- （團隊）你們真的在打瞌睡嗎？- 還沒。
translations.id: - Aku belum tidur hari ini. - Tidak apa-apa. - (Tim) Kamu benar-benar mengantuk? - Belum.
translations.pt: - Eu não dormi hoje. - Tudo bem. - (Equipe) Você está pegando no sono mesmo? - Ainda não.

transcript.text: It's very clear. What is this? They have something for us to read.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャット・ジェン・チャン・アライ・ニー・ミー・コーン・ハイ・アーン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: It 's very clear . What is this ? They have something for us to read .

translations.ja: すごくはっきりしてる。何これ？読むものがあるみたいだよ
translations.en: It's very clear. What is this? They have something for us to read.
translations.ko: 아주 선명하네. 이게 뭐야? 우리보고 읽으라는 게 있네.
translations.zh-TW: 非常清楚。這是什麼？他們有東西要我們讀。
translations.id: Sangat jelas. Apa ini? Mereka punya sesuatu untuk kita baca.
translations.pt: Está muito claro. O que é isto? Eles deixaram algo para lermos.

transcript.text: This is your secret mission. Accomplish it, and keep it a secret. Don't get caught until the time of revelation.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ニー・クー・パリン・キット・ラップ・モー・タム・ハイ・サム・レック・ユラ・チャップ・ジョン・トゥン・ウェラー・プアイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: This is your secret mission . Accomplish it , and keep it a secret . Don 't get caught until the time of revelation .

translations.ja: これが君たちのシークレットミッションだ。やり遂げて、秘密にしておくこと。明かされる時まで見つからないようにね
translations.en: This is your secret mission. Accomplish it, and keep it a secret. Don't get caught until the time of revelation.
translations.ko: 이건 너희들의 비밀 임무야. 완수하고 비밀로 해. 계시의 때가 올 때까지 들키지 마.
translations.zh-TW: 這是你的秘密任務。完成它，並好好保密。在揭曉答案之前別被抓到。
translations.id: Ini adalah misi rahasiamu. Selesaikan, dan simpan sebagai rahasia. Jangan sampai ketahuan sampai waktu pengungkapan.
translations.pt: Esta é a sua missão secreta. Conclua-a e mantenha-a em segredo. Não seja pego até o momento da revelação.
